counselling-archaeology-careers.title: Career counselling in archaeology and heritage
counselling-archaeology-careers.subtitle: A private online session on study and career choices
counselling-archaeology-careers.description:
A one-to-one conversation about your next step: which master's or doctoral programmes suit you, how entrance examinations and fieldwork applications work, and what roles exist in museums, survey, conservation and heritage management.

The session is held online at a time agreed with you.

details.Scheduling: A time is agreed with you
details.Length and fee: About 60 minutes. From ₹1,500 per session, including GST

tiers.label: One-to-one, online
tiers.note: About 60 minutes, with written next steps

tiers.label: Application clinic
tiers.note: Includes a review of your statement of purpose and CV

notes: Everything can be changed to suit you: length, route, level, language, date and group size. Tell us what you need and we will quote.
pricing.gst: All prices include GST. A GST invoice is issued on request.

sakta-ethos-devimahatmya-recording.title: The Śākta ethos in the Devīmāhātmya
sakta-ethos-devimahatmya-recording.subtitle: A lecture recording on the Goddess and the Śākta tradition
sakta-ethos-devimahatmya-recording.description: A lecture on how the Devīmāhātmya presents the Goddess, and what the text reveals about the Śākta and tantric traditions that developed around it.

brahmi-script-chart-a3.title: Brāhmī script chart
brahmi-script-chart-a3.subtitle: A wall chart of Aśokan Brāhmī with Devanāgarī and roman equivalents
brahmi-script-chart-a3.description: Each letter of Aśokan Brāhmī set beside its Devanāgarī and IAST equivalent, at a size that can be read across a classroom.

trench-field-notebook.title: Field notebook
trench-field-notebook.subtitle: A gridded pocket notebook for site visits
trench-field-notebook.description: A pocket notebook for site visits, with gridded pages for plans and sections and a printed scale along the cover edge.

monuments-postcard-set.title: Indian monuments postcard set
monuments-postcard-set.subtitle: Twelve postcards of measured monument drawings
monuments-postcard-set.description: Twelve postcards, each with a measured elevation drawing of an Indian monument on the front and a short note on its date and features on the back.

harappan-seals-reading-pack.title: Harappan seals reading pack
harappan-seals-reading-pack.subtitle: A printed booklet with a recorded introduction
harappan-seals-reading-pack.description: A booklet on how Harappan seals were made, used and excavated, illustrated with drawings of seals, accompanied by a recorded introduction.
